objective: Determine whether low-complexity directional geometry among already-computed pexprb54s4 nonlinear remainders D2,D3,D4 carries family-robust safety information beyond scalar stage-shape features.

data_roles.N192: sealed independent calibration; forbidden unless a vector witness survives discovery

physical_component_rule: Use exactly the same physical-component prefix norm_component_count used by the tolerance-scaled early-flow-defect telemetry; exclude any trailing time-augmentation clock component.
feature_domain: If any required norm is zero/nonfinite or a dot product is nonfinite, the affected directional feature is null. Finite cosine values are clamped only to [-1,1] to remove floating roundoff outside the mathematical range.

numerical_work_contract.allowed_diagnostic_work: physical-prefix dot products, L2 norms, scalar arithmetic only

discovery_robustness_gate.survivor_rule: At most one predeclared vector witness may advance. It must materially improve on the v3.0 scalar kappa234 baseline and must not collapse toward chance under either dimension or leave-one-family-out checks. Numeric thresholds remain forbidden on discovery data.

forbidden: N192 execution before a witness survives discovery
